commands.status: Read-only policy/tool/payload/current-owned-wrapper status. --require-ready fails unless native tests, Android passthrough, request consumption and stock Recovery evidence match.
commands.probe: Read only active BOOT and current Android identity. Reject unknown headers, nested wrappers, malformed layout, slot changes and incompatible GKI. Emit bounded reconstruction metadata, never a whole stock BOOT copy.
commands.repack: Extract the current ROM GKI at runtime, preserve normal init_boot/vendor_boot use, embed selector/FD/APP. With --execute re-read source hash, slot and both fingerprints; write only matching active BOOT, then read back. No inactive-slot, REC, vbmeta or GPT write.
commands.restore: Verify the currently active wrapper belongs to the same current ROM and source identity. Reconstruct the original kernel/header/footer from embedded original bytes and metadata; verify exact original-image SHA before writing/readback. Refuse an OTA or changed slot; never restore a historical ROM image.
commands.request: The planned module command remains unimplemented. The separate piano-boot-request native tool can update the owned NEXTv1 pages and is file-tested, but Android execution and automatic consumption remain unverified. Do not write PMIC/misc or issue an unknown reboot command.

entry_policy: Without a valid owned request, NORMAL and REC pass through to the current ROM kernel; reboot recovery retains original Mi Recovery. Two 4 KiB NEXTv1 pages follow the original GKI span and precede the SPLITv1 selector. The native file repacker adds an RSTRv1 lossless restore catalog. Native file repack/restore and request-page interoperability are verified with a real stock BOOT; the new wrapper device boot, online module writes, automatic consumption and sticky policy remain unverified. sunuefi.boot=uefi is a host diagnostic override.
webui: KernelSU webroot and Magisk action.sh are source entry points. MMRL is an optional external WebUI host. No root-command strings are embedded in JavaScript; a future verified adapter must invoke the bounded action.sh status/preview/request interfaces. Until the adapter and native request consumer are verified, request buttons are disabled.

reconstruction.storage: The native file tool preserves one original GKI, original BOOT/GKI headers and nonzero tail blocks with offsets in the embedded RSTRv1 catalog. Restoring reconstructs zero regions and verifies the exact original BOOT SHA256. Planned online slot/fingerprint/ownership checks and writes are not implemented.

fresh_partition_install.phase_1: Explicit volume-key confirmation; verified helper validates current GPT and F2FS, shrinks online, reads both plaintext superblocks and stores a hash-bound pending plan. Reboot Android before GPT changes.
fresh_partition_install.phase_2: After a normal Android reboot and new explicit confirmation, helper must verify the same plan/GPT and both smaller superblocks. Write backup GPT before primary with readback; reboot again before using new partition nodes.
fresh_partition_install.current_behavior: Any nonzero choice fails before all writes because the helper has not been validated. No dd or force fallback.
